items.title: Omer Simeon Interview, 1955-08-18
items.q: Then later on, Jimmy Mundy. And he has become quite a famous arranger now.

ctx.x: What is their rhythm or their style?

Well I would advise all the students on any instrument, I mean, to try to develop their own style of playing and their own tone. It doesn't necessarily mean, I mean, to play jazz, that you have to copy another man's style, or copy his tone, probably played 40, 50 years ago. So try to develop your own tone and your own style of playing. All the clarinets in New Orleans had different styles. Johnny's style was different than Jimmy's. All of them, they had their own individual style. So I would advise all the…
And that's about all that you've got on. Can you tell us some more about your lessons with Teo and your counting and rhythm?
